name: Agent Hub 多AI协作
description: Agent Hub 多 AI 协作平台：代码评审（多家大模型并行评审 diff 并汇总裁决）与方案共创（Kimi/MiniMax/DeepSeek 三家出方案、交叉互评、人工拍板后产出 AI 编写定稿、可迭代）。
description_zh: Agent Hub 多 AI 协作平台，两大能力：①代码评审——把代码 diff 提交给 Kimi/MiniMax/DeepSeek 等多家大模型并行评审并自动汇总裁决，返回 approve / comment / request_changes 结论；②方案共创——发布想法后四家 AI 独立出方案、互相评审，用户拍板选定后由产出 AI 编写定稿，并可发起多轮迭代优化。
description_en: Agent Hub multi-AI collaboration platform with two modes: ①Code Review — submit a diff, multiple LLMs review in parallel and a consensus verdict (approve / comment / request_changes) is returned; ②Proposal Collab — four AIs (Kimi/MiniMax/DeepSeek/Qwen) each draft a plan, cross-review each other, then the user picks one and the producing AI writes the final plan, with support for iterative refinement rounds.
examples_zh: 帮我评审这段代码改动有没有问题
把这个 diff 提交给多家 AI 评审并告诉我结论
我想做一个团队周报自动化工具，让三家 AI 各出一个方案并互评
查询方案共创任务 pp_20260919_xxx 的最新进度
选定 kimi 的方案并让它补充数据安全设计后写定稿
对已定稿的方案发起一轮迭代，重点压缩实施成本
examples_en: Review this code diff for potential issues
Submit this diff to multiple AI reviewers and give me the verdict
I want to build an automated weekly report tool — have three AIs each propose a plan and cross-review them
Check the progress of proposal task pp_20260919_xxx
Pick Kimi's plan and have it write the final version with extra data-security requirements
Start an iteration round on the finalized plan, focusing on cutting implementation cost
